title: Open installation status after AppSource install failure
summary: When an AppSource installation fails synchronously, users now see a prompt offering to open the Extension Installation Status page instead of the operation closing silently.
key_points: Failed AppSource installations now display a prompt to open installation status
Complements platform-side changes that record failures for published global apps
UI enhancement without schema or public API modifications
Includes test coverage for prompt acceptance and decline scenarios
Low-risk change to extension marketplace management
quote: When a synchronous AppSource installation fails, prompt the user to open Extension Installation Status instead of closing silently.
